checklist_items.1.1: After the register dialog source is the local path, the dialog shows two comboboxes and two textboxes and no spinbutton. The source combobox is required and its selected text is the localized local-path label. The node combobox is an empty required searchable select: its root has the show-search class and its placeholder is the localized select-an-online-node sentence. Model directory is an empty required textbox, its placeholder is /models/Qwen/Qwen3-8B, it has no maximum length, and its form extra is the localized directory-help sentence. Name is an empty textbox that is not marked required, and its placeholder is the localized optional display name. There is no storage combobox, no model ID, no directory URL, and no revision. The preview POST sends the selected node and the typed directory, and the preview reports architecture Qwen2ForCausalLM and the fixture weight. The register POST sends that node, that directory, the typed model ID, and the typed name, and returns 201. The independent GET stores source local, that model ID, that name, architecture Qwen2ForCausalLM, and the fixture weight, with one registered node file at that directory and an empty storages list. The local agent reads that directory for the preview.
checklist_items.1.7: Minimum local registration reaches the exact preview and register bodies
checklist_items.1.8: The parsed local directory shows one success alert, and that alert contains the localized parsed text. The complete registration fills the only optional field, the display name. That POST and the independent GET store that typed name. After that model is deleted, a second registration clears the display name and types a different model ID. That POST carries an empty name and that model ID. The independent GET stores the directory basename as the name and stores that model ID. After reload the directory basename stays visible. The empty name uses the path basename and does not use the typed model ID.
checklist_items.1.9: While the local register POST is held the confirm button stays loading and a second click sends no further registration. The later 201 is the only stored model
checklist_items.1.10: The 502 keeps the register dialog and the model ID, name and directory, shows the registration-failed prefix and upstream fixture is unreachable, and the models list stays empty. The retry 201 matches the independent GET
checklist_items.1.11: Cancel, the close button and Escape each close the register dialog immediately, with no unsaved-changes prompt and no preview or registration write. The independent models GET stays equal to the list read before the dialog opened
checklist_items.1.14: Refresh and independent GET preserve the registered model and its node-file association
checklist_items.5.5: Choosing the local source reveals the node picker and directory field
checklist_items.8.1: The node picker offers the online agent node with its readable name
checklist_items.12.1: Local register on the models page opens one dialog named by the register title, and the directory field is the visible business control
checklist_items.12.2: The model files dialog opens inside the 1440x900 viewport and shows the node, path and registered state
checklist_items.12.3: Default focus is inside the local register dialog. Tab and Shift+Tab each cycle across at least two controls and never leave the dialog
checklist_items.12.4: Cancel, Escape, the close button and the mask each return focus to the page register button and send no preview or registration write. The independent models GET stays unchanged
checklist_items.12.6: covered: While the local register is held the confirm button shows the loading state and a second click sends no further POST; the 502 keeps the model ID, name and directory, shows the registration-failed prefix and upstream fixture is unreachable, and stores nothing; the later 201 matches the independent GET and the reloaded model
checklist_items.12.7: Delete confirmation names the model and says node copy records are removed and a deployment reference blocks deletion. A deployment row blocks deletion with 409 MODEL_IN_USE and the model and deployment stay. A model file whose state is deleting keeps the model on 409 and the file stays. After both rows are cleared, delete returns 204, the independent GET is 404, and the reloaded list is empty
